column1: # The API scan's groups (Phase 11 C283.1; Workflow 11F, dast-11f): each OpenAPI tag of the stack's
# /openapi.json in exactly one group, so each group's scan fits one 10-minute call (rule 8), and the
# credential each group's requests carry, as its operations declare it:
#   apiKey       the run's sandbox API key holding every sandbox scope (the server API);
#   userSession  a seeded sandbox admin's console session, its own (the dashboard API);
#   sessionToken the run's hosted-flow session (the flow API; `run.sh flow routes` scans it, with
#                the run's own handoff as the example of the three public handoff routes).
# One line each: group TAB auth TAB tag,tag,...; or hold TAB METHOD /path TAB reason for an
# operation the scan must not call (it would end a credential another scan of the run still holds).
# Each group is small enough that ZAP's 38 active rules finish within its call: at 6 minutes, a
# group of 58 operations finished 17 of them, and groups whose parameters are many (the API log's
# search, the case routes) finished 23 to 28 of 38 at 30 operations (2026-11-21, docs/security/dast-*.md).
# A tag@/prefix entry takes one tag's operations under that path prefix (the dashboard tag's 70).
# security/tests/test_dast_zap.py and infra/tests/zap.test.sh hold this file against
# docs/api/openapi.json: a new tag fails them until it is placed here.
